title: Malaysian Beef Noodle Soup
description: A hearty and flavorful noodle soup originating from Malaysia, made with beef, fermented elements, and a rich broth.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the onions and garlic and cook until the onions are translucent.
Add the beef broth, fermented fish sauce, fish sauce, and ginger to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the Malaysian noodles to the pot and cook for 8-10 minutes, or until they are tender.
Stir in the lime juice and season the soup with salt to taste.
Serve the soup hot, garnished with chopped herbs if desired.
Reheat the soup for 5-7 minutes before serving if needed.
Serve the soup immediately and enjoy!
Store leftovers in the refrigerator for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 2 months.
